aggregation.candidate: KMeans K2, n_init10; unweighted mean state maps
aggregation.features: nonself absolute Lasso coefficients, standardised per feature across windows with std+1e-8
aggregation.gate: two nonempty groups and (improvement>=.12 or (improvement>=.04 and coherence>=.55 and minimum_fraction>=.10))
aggregation.native_fallback: same window scores collapsed by static maximum
aggregation.self_lags: included in regression; excluded from scored edges and clustering features

inference.B_duration_difference_family: three paired Gamma=Delta(600)-Delta(300), one per schedule; two-sided t, Holm3
inference.B_forced_family: six two-sided paired-repeat one-sample t tests; Holm6
inference.intervals: pointwise paired-repeat percentile bootstrap; not simultaneous intervals
inference.missing: retain failures and undefined targets; finite complete pairs only, no 0.5 imputation; fixed family size retained

paired_unit: independent mechanism/initialisation/innovation repeat, shared across all six cells
primary_estimand_within_B: forced_hard minus raw_window changing-edge temporal AUROC
retained: base coefficients/support/initial values/innovations; full and observed schedules/series; window scores/labels/maps/purity; actual and centre switches; J,C,JC and edge denominators

rng.base_helper: SeedSequence([input_seed,domain]): domain0 coefficients, domain1 initial values, domain2 innovations
rng.seed_derivation: little-endian first128 SHA256 bits of canonical compact JSON [namespace, repeat_seed, domain, *parts]; clustering first32 bits

role: prespecified secondary schedule robustness; separate from A confirmatory family

schedule.censoring: retain sampled/full-time segments and flag burn-in/endpoint truncation
schedule.fixed_phase: full time origin0, state=floor(t/D)%2, then discard100 burn-in
schedule.irregular: full origin0 state0, alternating states, independent inclusive integerUniform[ceil(.75D),floor(1.25D)] lengths before burn-in

stability: preserve existing one-pass scalar stabilisation; report actual spectral radii, no rejection/resampling
